scripts.test:api:quick: bash -c 'echo "Testing Quick Path API..." && curl -X POST "$NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL/api/v1/external/design/quick" -H "Authorization: Bearer $NEXT_PUBLIC_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: multipart/form-data" -F "target_file=@examples/target_proteins/egfr.pdb" -F "target_name=EGFR_test" -F "hotspot_residues=A:50-65,A:120-135" -F "binder_length_range=50-150" -F "num_designs=5" | jq'
scripts.test:api:pipeline: bash -c 'echo "Testing Pipeline Path API..." && echo "1. Getting presigned upload URL..." && UPLOAD_RESPONSE=$(curl -s -X POST "$NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL/api/v1/files/upload-url" -H "Authorization: Bearer $NEXT_PUBLIC_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"filename":"test.pdb","content_type":"chemical/x-pdb","file_category":"structure","tags":{},"expires_hours":24}') && echo $UPLOAD_RESPONSE | jq && echo "2. Upload to S3 (manual step required)" && echo "3. Confirm upload (manual step required)" && echo "4. Create pipeline (manual step required)"'
scripts.test:config: node -r dotenv/config -e 'require("dotenv").config({path:".env.local"}); console.log("API Base URL:", process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL || "NOT SET"); console.log("API Key:", process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_KEY ? "SET (" + process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_KEY.length + " chars)" : "NOT SET");'
